content.text:
This is an overhead photo of one plate of food from a cafeteria.
List every visible food on the plate, at most 20 items. For each item, estimate its weight in grams and its food energy in kilocalories (kcal).
Reply with only one JSON object in exactly this shape, and nothing else:
{"items": [{"name": "<food name>", "grams": <number>, "kcal": <number>}]}
Use an empty list if no food is visible.

{"items": [{"name": "baked white fish fillet with herb crust", "grams": 90, "kcal": 140}, {"name": "red rice and grain pilaf topping", "grams": 60, "kcal": 90}, {"name": "arugula salad", "grams": 55, "kcal": 25}, {"name": "steamed cauliflower florets", "grams": 110, "kcal": 28}, {"name": "pine nuts", "grams": 6, "kcal": 40}, {"name": "corn kernels", "grams": 12, "kcal": 12}, {"name": "apple slices", "grams": 20, "kcal": 10}, {"name": "edamame or green beans", "grams": 12, "kcal": 14}, {"name": "dressing/oil", "grams": 8, "kcal": 50}]}
